note: Native status of Camassia quamash, Fragaria virginiana, Eriophyllum lanatum, Achillea/Ranunculus occidentalis inferred from species identity; Prunella vulgaris (e23, native status ambiguous) and seeded forbs (e40, not stated native) excluded. Burn+herbicide combination treatments kept as prescribed-fire instances. Wildfire severity/fire history, microbes (e13, e47), canopy/understory cover (e54, e44) and known non-natives excluded.

Native-cover outcomes (e8, e10, e47, e48, e53) excluded as the narrower native-species-cover class, not overall plant cover; single-species, moss and woody-debris/slash edges excluded. Including native cover would change the answer.
Only hatchery-fish genetic diversity (heterozygosity, allelic richness) edges, not Shannon/evenness diversity indices; e6 also compares two hatchery cohorts.
e7 (warm and dry summer -> bare/disturbed donor site category) excluded: cause mixes temperature with drought and outcome is a site-type category; including it would not change the label.
Slash (logging residue) counted as dead wood left on site. Moss, vascular, woody-plant cover and bare ground excluded as narrower/neighbouring outcomes; tree cover is not retained trees.

Excluded: water level/table edges (e23, e56), sown or planted establishment (e13, e22), seedling growth/mortality (e15, e18, e37), and e19 (water addition enabling ongoing Agropyron germination, no clear sign).
Competition/vegetation-control edges only reach individual seedling diameter or growth (e2, e9, e10, e13, e17, e25, e33, e50, e51, e57), judged tree growth rather than stand structure or basal area.

Rusty crayfish (e28) taken as invasive from species identity. e22 (algal pigment-group abundance) excluded as not population size; exotic hand-pulling edges (e42, e60) and combined management edges excluded; coho not stated non-native.
